input.text:
Chappell Roan is gaining about 784K Spotify monthly listeners a day, and two things line up behind it. 🔥

As of Oct 20, 2026 she has 33.9M monthly listeners (+2.37% in a day, per kworb) and 5.4M Spotify streams a day across her catalog. The pop star behind "Good Luck, Babe!", "Pink Pony Club" and "HOT TO GO!" has 8.85B lifetime Spotify streams.

Reason one: "expectations (feat. Chappell Roan)", the remix of Olivia Rodrigo's single, came out Oct 15 and is her first time as a featured guest on someone else's song (Stereogum). Her new verse replaces the original second verse, and the video has David Byrne as a game-show host. On Oct 19 it sat at #6 on Spotify's global daily chart with 3.5M streams.

Reason two: the Super Graphic Spectacular, two benefit nights at the Shrine in Los Angeles on Oct 21 and 22, with all net proceeds going to her Midwest Princess Project for trans youth and LGBTQ+ communities.

The catalog is doing the rest: "Good Luck, Babe!" is still at 1.37M streams a day, ahead of "Pink Pony Club" (858K) and "Casual" (856K). Album two? She said in Aug 2025 it could take five years or more.

Which Chappell Roan song never leaves your rotation? 👇

Data: Spotify monthly listeners, kworb Spotify streams, Stereogum, Clash, Variety, Line of Best Fit · as of Oct 20, 2026

#chappellroan #oliviarodrigo #popmusic #spotifycharts #goodluckbabe
